formal_name: Decision-First Chess Judgment & Rival-Line Commentary: Two Historic Source-Native Development Cases and Honest Comparator Limit
source: Public historical PGN legally replayed, official SF16 cold scout depth9 MultiPV3, root-restricted two-rival depth12 MultiPV2, Threads1 Hash16 NNUE OFF; matched source condition only within each pair. I9 separate baseline uses 4000 nodes/ply and is NOT equivalent compute budget.

cases.actual_i9_note: Rxd4 is a capture. Rxd4 is the engine's first candidate in this analysis. In the bounded verified principal variation, the line continues Rxd4 cxd4 Nc6+ Kb6 Qxd4+ Qc5; the replay contains check, capture.
cases.verified_tactic_asymmetry: Rxd4: capture. Nc6+: check plus attack on king and rook d8.

cases.actual_i9_note: O-O-O castles. Against O-O-O, the engine prefers Bxf6 by about 6 centipawns in this bounded analysis. In the bounded verified principal variation, the line continues Bxf6 gxf6 O-O-O Rd8 Kb1 a6; the replay contains capture.
cases.verified_tactic_asymmetry: O-O-O: castling rook to d1, Bxf6: knight capture followed by gxf6.
